reason: The row applies logged rules and adds no new one. GAP RULE v2 (1) (CONTEXT l.4010-4014), freeze (1) (l.4184-4186), R36-A2 (i) for exp89t (l.4444-4445: 'a + with L_hi 10.2-10.75 h stands flagged UNPROVEN-ins'), R37-A7 (2) and card v5 l.17/l.84/l.124 all say the same thing: a COMPLETE CI read of >= 0.960 with 10.2 h < L_hi <= 10.75 h is a normal read with the UNPROVEN-ins flag, so the T1 outcome follows (V_pub exp89t, pair П3 {exp89t 56669888, #37 56563521}). The edges check out: 09:00:17Z + 10.2 h = 19:12:17Z (22:12 MSK), and + 10.75 h = 19:45:17Z (22:45 MSK). Both fall before the 20:00Z tick deadline. The row is not a closed line in disguise and costs 0 GPU and 0 extra Kaggle calls (text only). A Kaggle code-comp run produces one CSV for public and private together, so a skipped tail insertion is already in the scored file and nothing gets re-run. The tail-skip risk is <= ~0.0005 (CONTEXT l.3750). One flaw, in the wording only: the proposed clause says 'завершился после 22:12 МСК', but the rule keys on L_hi (first terminal poll header + 210 s x failed attempts), not on the completion time. A file that completes at ~22:05 MSK but is first seen at the 22:14 header also lands in this row. The scan flagged this same flaw as G3 in card v2 l.48, and T2 repeats it. Minor points: the 'ins-tail?' condition L_lo > 9.6 h is in practice always true in this band (L_lo ~ L_hi - 0.17 h at a 10-min cadence), so the footnote is effectively unconditional. P(T2) is small, ~1-3% for L in the band times <= ~0.11 for >= 0.960, which gives ~0.1-0.3%.
fix: Keep the row and the T1 untick/tick variants. Replace the clause with: '(поллер показал его завершённым только после 22:12 МСК, L_hi > 10,2 ч: пометка UNPROVEN-ins — гейт вставки мог сработать на последних клипах (≤ ~0,0005); по записанному правилу это обычное чтение)'. Compute the band from the header: H + 210 s x F in (19:12:17Z, 19:45:17Z], not the completion time. Add the footnote 'ins-tail?' whenever L_lo > 9.6 h (almost always true here). Put ', UNPROVEN-ins' in V_PUB_KIND (card template l.125).
realistic_gain: About 0.1-0.3% chance the row fires. When it does, it sends V_pub correctly to a 0.960 CI file 15-48 min before the 23:00 MSK tick deadline and keeps the user from reading 'после 22:12' as a disqualifier. Private effect <= ~+0.001 public-equivalent, minus a <= ~0.0005 tail-insertion risk. Zero GPU, zero extra Kaggle calls.
